notes: All 12 group-B classes exist in DX9 (registered 0xB6E1F0..0xB6E4E6). DX9 code for the TU is contiguous 0x425F00..0x42B6D0+ and follows the SE per-class order (getDTI/ctor/createProperty/dtor per class, then all MyDTI::newInstance, then RailBase ctor/dtor/box accessors/Main, then Set x4, calcTarPos x4 + calcTarPosVirtualPlPos, calcLockOn, calcFov, calcRoll, calcZoomRate, calcTargetLockOn*). Vtable slot numbering is identical between SE and DX9 (no shift). DX9 parent of cCameraNormal and the cCameraRail* / cCameraPan classes is cCameraRailBase (DTI 0xE56E08), whose parent is cCameraBase (DTI 0xE56C28, group A). ICF in DX9: Rail/Em025/Em026 share calcFov 0x42AF30, calcRoll 0x42AF70, calcZoomRate 0x42B0D0, getZoomType 0x427C90, getBattleZoomRate 0x427CA0, createProperty 0x427980 (SE also shares the last three); Rail/Em025 share calcLockOn 0x42AEA0, calcTargetLockOn 0x42B2E0, calcTargetLockOnYOnly 0x42B580. Folded bodies are named for cCameraRail (cCameraRailEm026 where SE already named the shared body so). Undefined code defined this pass: 16 bodies (9 deleting dtors, 6 MyDTI::newInstance, cCameraPan ctor 0x427480). Vtable labels added for 9 class vtables + 12 MyDTI vtables (0xB98C58 was mislabeled MtDTI_vtbl42_). 0x428360 carried a FLIRT false-positive name (Concurrency::...::GetIScheduler, FUNC_LIB) - replaced by cCameraRailBase::getBoxNum and LIB flag cleared. SE-only / dead-stripped in DX9: usage/operator new/delete helpers (84), copyArea x6, cCameraRailBase::MainEm026, cCameraPan::calcTargetLockOnYOnly (all unreferenced in SE). Shared generic bodies recorded without renaming: 0x455B10 (sdd for cCamAreaConnect/cCamPanData/cCameraRect3D) and 0x8FC2F0 (cCameraRailBase::createUI slot 1, 981 refs).
